patch_description: Add a small path-relinking neighborhood toward a strong, structurally distant network already scored by the LP. Each intermediate is generated by a degree-preserving two-switch that increases overlap with the target, so the path moves deliberately toward another promising region rather than taking arbitrary kicks. A few best-overlap choices are added as proposals for the existing surrogate screen; the search does not spend LP calls on every path step. This gives stalled and non-stalled parents a bounded way to combine good structures from distinct archive members without substantially increasing neighborhood-generation cost.
